title: Q workflow material-task lifecycle contract
scope: Material work only; exact commands and tiny deterministic edits stay on the micro path.

authority.canonical_source: A registered repository source is the only normal edit authority.
authority.bootstrap: A validated installation input; never a merge or push source.
authority.runtime: A rebuildable execution output; runtime-newer is blocked until backfilled to source.
authority.remote: A fetched remote ref is evidence only after an explicit successful fetch. Offline or cached tracking state is remote-unproven.

task_state.focus_rule: ACTIVE_WORK selects one task; every registered task remains inspectable by task_id or trace_id.
task_state.transaction_rule: Plan first, then apply with compare-and-swap hashes, exclusive lock, atomic replacement, readback validation, rollback, and a receipt.

transition_rules: A material task starts at briefing/local-validated/local-only and has a durable task_id and authority_event.
Every promote, pause, block, resume, validation completion, and close writes an event before a completion claim.
A context compaction or cold resume increments execution_epoch while preserving trace_id; a mismatched state_revision blocks resume. Direct closed-to-active is prohibited.
integrity_state=stale, drift, or conflicted blocks sync, push, release, and stable claims.
release_state=ready or released requires remote_status=proven, remote_proven=true, a release_receipt, strict readiness and explicit signoff evidence; local validation alone cannot set either state.
expert_gate: For non-simple work, a deterministic role plan must name a primary owner before active; mapped reviewer and validator gates must be completed or explicitly deferred before close.
receipt: A reconciliation receipt is written only after all selected source/bootstrap/runtime checks pass. For ready/released it is JSON under the authoritative hub reports root with format_version=1, remote, branch, timezone-qualified fetched_at, matching hexadecimal remote_head and target_oid, strict_readiness_status=pass and signoff_id. The pointer binds release_remote, release_branch, release_fetched_at, release_target_oid, signoff_id and release_receipt_sha256 to the same receipt; remote_proven=true is allowed only after this verified fetch evidence.
compatibility: Unknown human Markdown is preserved. Machine records use format_version; future major versions fail closed, while extension fields are preserved where documented. RECOVERY_POINTER v1 remains a flattened focus view; sync_state is a derived legacy alias and domain-specific states belong under task-record detail.
